description: Retrospective, primary-source-linked 3 November 2026 exam notes on Pune Metro, telecom interconnection, maritime rescue, eCourts eFiling, proposed drug-import rules, indigenous AI, COP31, science benchmarking and CRPF; 14 original revision MCQs. Compiled after the edition date.

stories.title: Pune Metro inauguration and foundation-stone projects worth around ₹21,800 crore
stories.summary: On 3 November, the Prime Minister inaugurated and laid foundation stones for a group of Pune Metro projects valued at around ₹21,800 crore through video conferencing. The government linked the works to improved urban connectivity and productivity. The reported amount covers projects at different stages, not only lines already operating.
key_facts: The inaugurated Hinjawadi–Shivajinagar corridor serves a major IT and employment hub in Pune.
The Prime Minister said this corridor was built through a public-private partnership model.
The speech described metro-network expansion as part of improving cities' ease of living and urban economic activity.
stories.exam_link: Revise urban transport infrastructure, public-private partnerships and the distinction between inauguration, foundation stone and commissioning.
stories.source_title: PIB, Prime Minister's Office, Pune Metro release, 3 November 2026

stories.title: TRAI notifies the third amendment to Telecommunication Interconnection Regulations
stories.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India released the Telecommunication Interconnection (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026 on 3 November. The changes seek a phased shift toward Licensed Service Area-level and IP-based interconnection between telecom providers. The regulations were announced with a future commencement date rather than being already operative on 3 November.
key_facts: The amendment takes effect on 1 January 2027.
All new interconnections established after commencement must be IP-based; existing E1/TDM interconnections are to be migrated over three years.
Existing LDCA/SDCA-level traffic is to move to Licensed Service Area-level points of interconnection over three years.
TRAI regulates interconnection under powers including Section 11(1)(b) of the TRAI Act, 1997.
stories.exam_link: Revise TRAI, the distinction between telecom interconnection and spectrum licensing, LSA, POI, IP networks and the phased migration timeline.

stories.title: Indian Navy reports rescue of 20 crew from hijacked fishing vessel Azini
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence reported that the Indian Navy freed fishing vessel Azini from pirates after an operation off Somalia's coast. The operation involved naval surveillance and intervention with Indian Air Force support. The announcement described all crew as rescued without injury or loss of life.
key_facts: All 20 crew members of Azini were reported rescued safely.
A maritime reconnaissance aircraft supported the operation, and an IAF C-17 enabled a precision airdrop of Marine Commandos.
The original hijacking was reported off the north-eastern coast of Somalia; concerns included the vessel being used as a pirate 'mother ship'.
stories.exam_link: Revise India's Indian Ocean security role, anti-piracy operations, inter-service coordination and the strategic importance of the Gulf of Aden and Somali waters.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Defence, Azini rescue, 3 November 2026

stories.title: Department of Justice announces eFiling 3.0 workshop under eCourts project
stories.summary: The Department of Justice announced a practical eFiling 3.0 workshop scheduled for 4 November under the eCourts Mission Mode Project. The programme was intended to familiarise government departments with digital court-filing workflows. This was a workshop announcement, not a claim that every court had completed eFiling implementation.
key_facts: The workshop was scheduled for 4 November 2026 at Vigyan Bhawan in New Delhi.
Technical sessions were to cover eCourts services, the eCourts mobile app, Single Sign-On and eFiling 3.0 functions.
Phase III of the eCourts project envisages end-to-end paperless, citizen-centric judicial services and universal eFiling adoption.
stories.exam_link: Connect eCourts Phase III with digital justice delivery, judicial services, NIC, electronic case filing and administrative adoption of court technology.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Law and Justice, eFiling 3.0 workshop announcement, 3 November 2026

stories.title: Draft proposal widens authorised gateways for imported drugs and medical devices
stories.summary: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare proposed an amendment to the Drugs Rules, 1945, to add import entry points for healthcare products. It aims to make customs and logistics access more convenient for medicines, medical devices and cosmetics. The additional gateways were proposed, not yet confirmed as notified and operational by this announcement.
key_facts: The proposed rule change concerns Rule 43A of the Drugs Rules, 1945.
Suggested additional sites include ICDs in Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, Telangana and Karnataka, plus the Bommasandra SEZ.
Noida International Airport in Uttar Pradesh was also proposed for drug imports by air.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Drugs Rules, authorised import gateways, inland container depots, Special Economic Zones and the difference between draft and final rules.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, drug-import gateway proposal, 3 November 2026

stories.title: IndiaAI Mission announces EKA-1 and Dhīr indigenous foundation models
stories.summary: The IndiaAI Mission, under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, announced indigenous AI foundation models developed by Soket and ZenteiQ. Its official release describes distinct multilingual model families intended to support research and deployment in Indian languages. Their announced specifications should not be confused with independent benchmarking results.
key_facts: EKA-1 by Soket was described as a 26.3-billion-parameter model trained across all 22 Scheduled Indian languages and English.
ZenteiQ announced Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B as multilingual assistants supporting English and 10 Indian languages.
The release placed these developments under the IndiaAI Innovation Centre pillar of the IndiaAI Mission.
stories.exam_link: Revise MeitY, the IndiaAI Mission, Scheduled languages, multilingual foundation models and model-size terminology.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, IndiaAI foundation models, 3 November 2026

stories.title: India outlines priorities ahead of UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya
stories.summary: India's Environment Minister presented the country's intended negotiating priorities before UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye. The ministry emphasised climate finance, equitable and solution-oriented approaches, adaptation, technology transfer and the concerns of the Global South. These were pre-conference priorities, not outcomes already agreed at COP31.
key_facts: The official briefing described COP31 as scheduled for 9–20 November 2026 in Antalya, Türkiye.
India prioritised predictable climate finance and party-driven mitigation and adaptation outcomes.
The briefing also highlighted technology transfer, just transition and context-specific capacity building.
stories.exam_link: Revise the UNFCCC Conference of the Parties, Global South, adaptation, mitigation, just transition and climate-finance negotiations.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, COP31 briefing, 3 November 2026

stories.title: NITI Aayog launches India S&T Scoreboard for State and UT comparisons
stories.summary: NITI Aayog launched an India Science and Technology Scoreboard to compare the research and innovation ecosystems of States and Union Territories. The initiative combines institutional and research-output measures so policymakers can identify strengths and development gaps. It is a monitoring and benchmarking platform, not a statement that each State has attained a particular target.
key_facts: The India S&T Scoreboard was launched in New Delhi on 3 November 2026.
Indicators include higher education and R&D institutions, deep-tech startups, incubators, publications and patents.
It also covers research quality, impact, collaboration, open access and sectors including academia, government R&D laboratories and industry.
stories.exam_link: Revise NITI Aayog, cooperative federalism, State-level innovation indicators, research publications, patents and evidence-based policy planning.
stories.source_title: PIB, NITI Aayog, India S&T Scoreboard, 3 November 2026

stories.title: Prime Minister highlights CRPF's reported 12-month zero-casualty milestone
stories.summary: The Prime Minister highlighted a reported CRPF record of no casualties during 12 consecutive months, stated as the first such period in 47 years. The announcement was a short recognition post and did not publish a detailed independent dataset or explain every operational casualty category.
key_facts: The statement was released by the Prime Minister's Office on 3 November 2026.
It highlighted twelve consecutive months and described the milestone as a first in 47 years.
The force named in the announcement was the Central Reserve Police Force, not the Central Industrial Security Force.
stories.exam_link: Revise the roles of India's Central Armed Police Forces, especially CRPF versus CISF and BSF, and distinguish a public announcement from audited security statistics.
stories.source_title: PIB, Prime Minister's Office, CRPF statement, 3 November 2026

mcqs.question: Pune Metro projects worth around ₹21,800 crore were inaugurated or initiated on 3 November 2026 through which mode?
options: Video conferencing by the Prime Minister
mcqs.explanation: PIB reported that the Prime Minister inaugurated and laid foundation stones for the Pune Metro projects by video conferencing.

mcqs.question: Which Pune Metro corridor was highlighted for connectivity to an important IT hub?
mcqs.explanation: The Pune Metro release specifically highlighted the newly inaugurated Hinjawadi–Shivajinagar corridor.

mcqs.question: The Telecommunication Interconnection (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026, take effect from which date?
mcqs.explanation: The TRAI announcement specifies commencement on 1 January 2027.

mcqs.question: Under TRAI's 2026 interconnection amendment, new interconnections after commencement must use which technology?
mcqs.explanation: TRAI's amendment requires new interconnections established after commencement to be IP-based.

mcqs.question: The Indian Navy said how many crew members were safely rescued from the fishing vessel Azini?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Defence reported the safe rescue of all 20 crew members.

mcqs.question: Which IAF aircraft was used to support the airdrop of Marine Commandos in the Azini operation?
mcqs.explanation: The official rescue account identifies an IAF C-17 for the precision airdrop.

mcqs.question: The eFiling 3.0 workshop announced on 3 November is part of which programme?
options: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan
mcqs.explanation: The Department of Justice described the eFiling 3.0 workshop as an initiative under the eCourts Mission Mode Project.

mcqs.question: The proposed expansion of drug-import gateways on 3 November concerned which provision?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare's draft amendment concerned Rule 43A of the Drugs Rules, 1945.

mcqs.question: EKA-1 and Dhīr AI foundation models were announced under which government mission?
mcqs.explanation: MeitY's official announcement described EKA-1 and Dhīr as models released under the IndiaAI Mission.

mcqs.question: According to the 3 November MeitY release, the EKA-1 foundation model has approximately how many parameters?
mcqs.explanation: The official release describes Soket's EKA-1 as a 26.3-billion-parameter model.

mcqs.question: Which city was announced as the host of UNFCCC COP31 scheduled for November 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The Environment Ministry's briefing identified Antalya, Türkiye, as the COP31 venue.

mcqs.question: Which item was identified as one of India's priorities before COP31?
options: An immediate global prohibition on solar energy
mcqs.explanation: India's pre-conference priorities included predictable climate finance, adaptation, technology transfer and just transition.

mcqs.question: The India S&T Scoreboard launched in New Delhi is an initiative of which institution?
mcqs.explanation: PIB identifies NITI Aayog as the institution launching the State and UT science and technology scoreboard.

mcqs.question: Which Central Armed Police Force was named in the Prime Minister's 3 November zero-casualty milestone statement?
mcqs.explanation: The Prime Minister's recognition statement named the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF).
